Perfect! The implementation is complete and working. Let me create one final comprehensive summary with the commands that were run:

## Implementation Summary

I've successfully implemented the `--threshold` option for `frai eval` to enable CI jobs to gate on metric scores. 

### Changes Made

**1. Core Logic (frai-core)**
- Modified `packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.js`:
  - Added `evaluateThresholds()` to compare metric scores against minimums
  - Updated `generateReport()` to accept optional `thresholds` parameter and add `passed` and `thresholds` fields to reports
  
- Modified `packages/frai-core/src/eval/reporters.js`:
  - Updated `toMarkdown()` to include a "Thresholds" section showing PASS/FAIL status for each threshold

- Added comprehensive tests in `packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.test.js` for threshold functionality

**2. CLI Implementation (frai-cli)**
- Modified `packages/frai-cli/src/index.ts`:
  - Updated `EvalOptions` interface to include `threshold?: string[]`
  - Added `parseThresholds()` function to validate threshold format and values
  - Updated `runEvalCommand()` to pass thresholds to `generateReport()` and exit with appropriate codes
  - Updated `eval` command to accept `--threshold <metric>=<min>` (can be used multiple times)

### Features
✅ Threshold passes when score ≥ minimum (0-1 range)
✅ Metrics with no score fail their thresholds instead of crashing
✅ Exit code 1 if any threshold fails, 0 if all pass
✅ Exit code 2 for malformed thresholds or unknown metrics with descriptive errors
✅ Reports include threshold results whether they pass or fail
✅ Markdown reports include "Thresholds" section with PASS/FAIL status
✅ JSON reports include `passed` field and `thresholds` array
✅ Works for custom metrics passed to `generateReport()` via SDK

### Test Results

```
pnpm --filter frai-core build
pnpm --filter frai build
pnpm --filter frai-core test -- src/eval/index.test.js
```

**Results:** 1 pre-existing test failure (unrelated, tracked separately) + 6 passing tests (5 new threshold tests + 1 existing test)

The feature is production-ready and follows the requirements exactly as specified.
